title: Choose the Road log layout
question: All three use the Forest Light look and the same fields. Lock the layout to build, or add a note to borrow from another.

options.label: One question at a time
options.thesis: Each part of the log gets the whole screen, so you answer with one thumb and never scroll.
options.viewport: Back to Road, a thin step rule, one large question such as How long did you walk? with a big minutes field, then Next.
options.risk: Six short screens for one entry, which is slower when you already know the numbers.

options.label: Two halves, docked save
options.thesis: One form in two titled parts, The walk and How it felt, with Save docked above the tabs.
options.viewport: Title, date choices, miles and minutes side by side in large numerals, terrain, then the effort scale; pain before and after below.
options.risk: The most familiar of the three, and the pain scales push the form past one screen.

options.label: Logbook line
options.thesis: The entry you are writing sits at the top as one ruled logbook line that fills in as you answer.
options.viewport: A ruled line reading Sat, Sep 26 · 2.1 mi · 41 min, the fields under it, Save, then earlier walks on the same rules.
options.risk: Form and history share one page, so it grows long once there are many walks.
